common.tickerTwo: NEW RELEASES AND FAVORITES IN ONE PLACE

recovery.title: Forgot your
recovery.intro: This is the first screen in the recovery flow. Sending codes is not available yet.
recovery.emailHint: Use the address you registered with.
recovery.stepOneBody: Type the address linked to your account.
recovery.stepTwoBody: The verification screen will appear here.
recovery.stepThreeBody: You will then be able to set a new password.
recovery.helpBody: If you do not recognize the address, check your account details before continuing.
recovery.footnote: Your favorites and orders stay in your account.

otp.title: Enter the 6 digits
otp.intro: The verification code will appear here once the flow is enabled.
otp.notice: There are no active codes in this view.
otp.codeHelp: The six fields will fill in when the form is active.
otp.channelNote: No active sends in this view.
otp.protectionBody: Your account is verified before a password change.
otp.helpBody: You can go back to the previous step to review your account details.
otp.footnote: You can return to sign in at any time.

password.title: Choose your new password
password.intro: You will be able to set a new password here once the flow is enabled.
password.strengthIdle: Strength will appear when the form is active
password.tipBody: Store your password in a trusted password manager.
password.helpBody: Go back to sign in to review the status of your account.
